groundTruthSource.note: Reviewed line 3 of go.mod at this commit: `go 1.20`. Go supports only its two newest release lines (https://go.dev/doc/devel/release#policy); the declared 1.20 line is older than both and receives no security fixes.

Reviewed line 5 of go.mod at this commit: `require github.com/golang/protobuf v1.5.4`. The module page at https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/golang/protobuf marks github.com/golang/protobuf deprecated in favour of google.golang.org/protobuf, which is why the require line is retired.
